sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
लोकेऽस्मिन् द्विविधा निष्ठा पुरा प्रोक्ता मयानघ ।
ज्ञानयोगेन साङ्ख्यानां कर्मयोगेन योगिनाम् ॥ ३-३॥
iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
loke’smin dvividhā niṣṭhā purā proktā mayānagha
jñānayogena sāṅkhyānāṃ karmayogena yoginām 3-3
translation: The Blessed Lord said : In this world there is a two-fold path, as I said before, O sinless one; the ‘Path-of-Knowledge’ of the SANKHYANS and the ‘Path-of-Action’ of the YOGINS.
